title: Race concurrent collections against one temporal high-water
preconditions: one active session has an accepted prior temporal high-water
steps: race two local collection requests from the same prior continuity state
submit both candidate intervals to the publisher verifier
attempt to obtain two successful transitions from one prior high-water
invariants: only one local collection is active for a protected session
the verifier atomically compares and advances temporal high-water
one prior high-water cannot authorize two successful transitions
residual_risk: availability can be reduced by deliberate collection races
